headline: Côte d'Ivoire: Massetou Traoré takes the helm of CREDAF GROUP
summary: Massetou Traoré, former deputy managing director of NSIA Banque Côte d'Ivoire, has been appointed CEO of CREDAF Group, overseeing seven Alios Finance entities.
why: CREDAF Group is a pan-African financial holding company with banking and financial subsidiaries across the continent.
original_headline: Côte d’Ivoire : Massetou Traoré prend les commandes de CREDAF GROUP
